leadText:
This male Trainer (Japanese: トレーナー Trainer) is a character of the day who appeared in If the Scarf Fits, Wear It!. 

He left his at the Day Care Center some time after the Pokémon Summer Academy. Angie was asked by her parents, who run the Day Care Center, to look after Lickitung while they were out on business. However, while doing so, she accidentally triggered its Evolution into , a scenario frowned upon by Day Care businesses. 

Though Angie's parents were angry at her for doing this, this Trainer was ecstatic because he didn't have the time to evolve Lickitung himself, thus allowing Angie to avoid any punishment.

==Trivia==
Much like Lt. Surge and Raymond, Lickilicky's Trainer uses several English phrases, such as "Oh my God" and "Thank you very much" in the Japanese version. In the English dub, he speaks in an Italian accent, even mentioning Italian phrases.
